purpose: Give every execution environment one repository-owned rule for resolving development, worktree, and production/use paths without hard-coded usernames or model-chosen clone locations.

development_checkout.fallback: the already-supplied current Git checkout only when its origin resolves to the required repository identity

invariants: A fresh agent must not invent a clone, install, Desktop, AppData, OneDrive, home, or worktree path from model preference.
An unresolved canonical development root is UNKNOWN, not permission to create another normal mutable checkout.
Ordinary mutation occurs in the canonical development checkout or approved worktree, never an UNKNOWN or ACTIVE production/use path.
A capability that has a production/use path must declare that path and its promotion/update boundary in its own capability contract.
If development and production resolve to the same physical path, every write is production-impacting.
Remote integration is not local deployment proof.
Runtime receipts must preserve shell/interpreter and execution-target uncertainty instead of guessing.
